title.description: Title for the summary extraction (e.g., 'Book 4 Unit 1 Themes').

text_summary_or_plot.description: A concise summary (exactly 1-2 sentences) of the text's narrative plot, main argument, or storyline for quick teacher reference.

estimated_reading_time.description: Estimated word count and reading time for student pacing reference (e.g., '350 words, approx. 4 minutes reading time').

essential_questions.description: A list of 2-3 engaging, open-ended warm-up or discussion questions to start the lesson.

lesson_hook.description: A brief creative activity idea, scenario, or question to hook students' interest at the beginning of the lesson.

concept_name.description: The name of the main topic, theme, or concept (e.g., 'Urbanization', 'Smart Technology').

educational_significance.description: The pedagogical takeaway: why this concept is important to learn and what core lesson it teaches.

key_details.description: Bullet points highlighting specific details, subtopics, or examples of this concept from the text.

related_connections.description: List of 1-3 short related topic titles (1-3 words maximum each, e.g. 'Personal Growth', 'Responsibility') suitable for Obsidian [[Wikilinks]]. DO NOT write full sentences or 'Connect to:' prefixes.

concepts.description: List of up to {count} unique main topics or concepts extracted from the text.
